name: Validated deterministic watchdog configuration
logic_name: Load a separate versioned deterministic watchdog policy with validated bounded thresholds

test_list.description: The embedded configuration exposes actual window, shingle, step-byte, and ratio settings without calibration claims.
Degenerate thresholds and values beyond hard bounds fail schema loading.

inputs.name: watchdog_config
inputs.description: Separate data-only config; not a model decision schema and has no calibration fields.

output_description: A typed deterministic configuration with nonzero ratios and bounded step/window/shingle settings.
